subject: use of grid viewports for laying out multiple figures

messages.author: c91a208fffacfb7e
messages.subject: use of grid viewports for laying out multiple figures
parts:
I am using and teaching the grid viewport manipulation described in
section 8.4.2 of Hadley's ggplot2 book for placing multiple figures,
such as different residual plots, on the same figure. I just wanted
to make sure that I didn't miss an easier way of accomplishing this.
For example, the print.trellis method allows some short cuts for
setting the viewport with its position and split arguments.

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: use of grid viewports for laying out multiple figures
parts:
Hi,

You might find the grid.arrange() function useful, it's in the
gridExtra package.

example,

source("http://gridextra.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/R/arrange.r")
library(ggplot2)
do.call(grid.arrange, lapply(1:5, function(.x)
qplot(1:10,rnorm(10),main=paste("plot",.x))))

HTH,

baptiste
